title: Billable package flattens Videos (no Sec nesting)
description:
Build Billable Package now copies every selected video, report, and image directly into Videos / Reports / Images — it no longer keeps WinCan Video/Sec nesting, and it no longer re-nests paths when two files share a name (those get a _2 suffix instead).

Who is affected: PipeShare users building customer billable packages on the private server, and on SaaS after Push.
changeLog: Billable Videos / Reports / Images folders are flat — files only, no Sec.
Duplicate file names get a _2 suffix instead of nested Video/Sec paths.
Wizard copy hint updated to describe the flat layout.
